question: In which of the following towns will you find the 'Kachari Ruins'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dimapur.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Kachari Ruins** or **The Dimasa Kachari Ruins** is located in the town of Dimapur in Nagaland.
 
• The ruins are a series of mushroom domed pillars that were created by the Dimasa Kachari Kingdoms that ruled before the Ahom invasion during the 13th century.
 
• The purpose and origin of the pillars are mysterious; few of the pillars stand in full glory while others are crumbled down.
 
• It is also believed that a game similar to that of chess was played here with the mushroom shaped dooms.
